      <section class="panel connect-panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>How to connect</h2>
          <p>Start the server, open this web page, then connect SDR++ to the virtual SDR++ Server output.</p>
        </div>
        <ol>
          <li>In SDR++, choose <b>Source → SDR++ Server</b>.</li>
          <li>Set <b>Host</b> to <code>51.77.216.96</code>
          </li><li>Set <b>Port</b> to <code>5259</code> and <b>Sample type</b> to <code>Int8</code>.</li>
          <li>Click <b>Connect</b>, press SDR++ play, and tune SDR++ near the transmit frequency shown above.</li>
          <li>Back here, choose your frequency/mode/audio settings and press <b>Start Transmission</b>.</li>
        </ol>
        <p class="small">Need help? Join the <a href="https://discord.gg/WkWPQTFhSv" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Discord support server</a>.</p>
      </section>
